meta.title: Privacy Policy
meta.subtitle: This privacy policy governs how Asian Spices Online B.V. handles the personal data of visitors, customers, and partners of our website, webshop, and app.

support.heading: Privacy Requests?
support.text: You can exercise your privacy rights or ask questions via our privacy mailbox.

blocks.text: When you use our website or app, place an order, create an account, or contact us, we sometimes need personal data. We treat this data with great care. In this privacy policy, we explain in clear language what data we use, why we do so, with whom we share data, how long we retain it, and what rights and choices you have.
We do not sell your personal data. We only share data when necessary for our services, when required by law, or when another valid legal basis exists.

items: We only collect data necessary for our services, security, legal obligations, or purposes for which you have given consent.
You can order with us using an account or as a guest.
For newsletters, non-necessary cookies, and certain forms of personalization, we ask for consent whenever legally required.
Partner stores receive only the data necessary to fulfill an assigned order.
You can exercise your privacy rights via support@asianspices.online.
We use technical and organizational measures to protect your data.

sections.title: 1. Who is responsible for your data?

blocks.text: Asian Spices Online B.V. is the data controller for the personal data described in this policy. This means that Asian Spices determines for which purposes and in what manner personal data is used.

sections.title: 2. Who does this policy apply to?

blocks.text: This policy applies to visitors and users of our website and webshop, the customer environment, the partner environment, and the mobile application (hereinafter: the app). The app is available for iOS and Android.
The policy applies, among other situations, when you:

items: Visit our website or app
Create or use a customer account or partner account
Place an order as a guest or with an account
Contact us via email, phone, chatbot, or contact form
Subscribe to a newsletter or other marketing communication
Leave a review or receive an invitation to leave a review
Use other features within our platform

blocks.text: 2.1 What is personal data?

Personal data is information that directly or indirectly relates to you. Examples include your name, address, email address, or phone number. An IP address, customer number, order history, account ID, device ID, or information about your usage of our website or app can also constitute personal data.
2.2 From whom do we receive personal data?
We receive most personal data directly from you. This occurs, for instance, when you create an account, place an order, fill out a form, contact us, subscribe to the newsletter, or leave a review.

In addition, we may receive data from third parties involved in our service provision. These include payment providers, CheapCargo and carriers, partner stores, and review providers. This may include payment statuses, transaction data, shipping or delivery information, or review processing details.
2.3 Which data is mandatory and which is optional?

Some data is necessary to create an account, fulfill an order, enter into a partner agreement, or provide another service requested by you. If you do not provide mandatory data, we may be unable to offer or perform the service in question. Data that is not strictly necessary is indicated as optional wherever possible.

sections.title: 3. On which legal bases do we process data?

blocks.text: We only process personal data when a valid legal basis exists. Depending on the purpose, we rely on one or more of the following legal bases:
Performance of a contract: processing is necessary to execute an order, account, partner agreement, or other agreed-upon service, or to take steps at your request prior to entering into a contract.
Legal obligation: processing is necessary to comply with, for example, tax, statutory accounting, food safety, or other legal obligations.
Consent: you have freely and clearly given consent, for example for a newsletter or non-necessary cookies. You can withdraw your consent at any time.

Legitimate interest: processing is necessary for a reasonable business interest, such as security, fraud prevention, customer support, improving our services, or establishing and defending legal claims. We balance this interest against your privacy rights.

sections.title: 4. Which data do we use in which situation?

blocks.text: 4.1 What happens when you use our website or app?

Which data? We may process technical data such as your IP address, browser and device information, operating system, session ID, request URL, timestamps, error logs, authentication events, and data regarding the usage of our website or app.

Why? We use this data to operate our digital services, monitor security and availability, troubleshoot errors, prevent fraud and abuse, and — where you have granted consent — analyze the use of our services and enhance the user experience.
Legal basis: performance of the requested service and our legitimate interest in necessary operation and security; consent for non-necessary analytics, marketing, and tracking technologies.
Retention period: the timeframe varies per technology and is detailed further in Section 8 and our Cookie Policy.
4.2 Which data do we use for your customer account?

Which data? To create and manage a customer account, we process your first name, last name, email address, phone number, and password. If you voluntarily add an address, we also process your address details. Additionally, we process your account ID, login timestamps, verification data, and the record of your 18+ age declaration.

Why? We use this data to create and manage your account, enable secure logins, verify your identity or contact details, recover passwords, keep you informed about your account and orders, provide customer support, and expedite future checkouts.

Your email address is used for account confirmations, critical account alerts, password resets, and order communication. Your phone number may be used for account security, one-time verification codes (OTP), and essential order or delivery updates. For account verification, a one-time verification code (OTP) may be sent via email or SMS.
Passwords are never stored in plain text. They are securely processed using a one-way cryptographic hash with a unique salt.
Legal basis: performance of the contract for account management; legitimate interest in account security, fraud prevention, and protection against unauthorized access.

Retention period: your account is retained for up to 24 months after the last activity. Before an inactive account is deleted, we may notify you. Afterward, we delete or anonymize account data, except data we are legally obligated to retain longer.
4.3 Which data do we need for an order?
You can place an order with an account or as a guest.

Which data? We process, among other items, your first name, last name, email address, phone number if provided, billing address, delivery address, postal code, city, country, order number, line items, customer notes, payment status, and creation and update timestamps.

Why? We use this data to process the order, record payment, organize delivery, send order updates, provide customer support, process returns and refunds, prevent fraud, and comply with legal requirements.
Legal basis: performance of the contract; legal obligation for relevant financial and statutory accounting records; legitimate interest in fraud prevention and case documentation.

Retention period: relevant order and invoice records forming part of our fiscal administration are stored in principle for 7 years. Where an applicable OSS or IOSS obligation applies, a 10-year retention period may apply. Other personal data from guest orders is kept for a maximum of 24 months following order completion, unless a longer period is required for a complaint, product recall, dispute, or legal requirement.
4.4 How do we process payments and refunds?

Which data? Asian Spices does not receive full payment card numbers, CVV/CVC codes, bank login credentials, or other sensitive payment credentials. We do receive data necessary for order management, customer support, and accounting, such as a transaction ID, payment status, payment method, amount, currency, timestamp, and payment reference.
Why? We use this data to link payments to orders, process payment statuses, respond to inquiries, execute refunds, and maintain our financial records.

Payments are processed via PAY. and PayPal. A refund is initiated by an authorized staff member and subsequently executed by the payment provider that processed the original payment. The refund is returned in principle to the original payment method.
Legal basis: performance of the contract and statutory accounting obligations.
Retention period: payment and invoice data that forms part of the tax administration is retained for the applicable statutory retention period.
4.5 How is your data used for delivery and partner stores?

Which data? An assigned partner store views the ordered products and postal code in the partner environment. For generating and printing the shipping label, your name and complete delivery address are made available. The partner store does not receive your email address or phone number, unless strictly necessary in an exceptional situation to fulfill the order and permitted by Asian Spices.

Why? The partner store uses this data exclusively to prepare the assigned order and dispatch shipment. The partner store may not use the data for its own marketing and will not contact you directly, unless Asian Spices deems this necessary and permissible in a specific situation.
Asian Spices remains your point of contact for complaints, returns, and refunds.

For booking shipments, we use CheapCargo. Depending on the shipment, a carrier such as DHL, PostNL, DPD, UPS, or another carrier available via CheapCargo may be deployed. For the shipping label, delivery, and track-and-trace, name, address details, phone number, and email address may be shared to the extent strictly necessary.
Legal basis: performance of the contract.
Retention period: shipping and delivery data is retained as long as necessary for delivery, customer support, returns, complaints, and applicable record-keeping.
4.6 What happens when you contact our customer support or chatbot?

Which data? We process the information you provide yourself, such as your name, contact details, account or order details, the contents of your message, attachments, and other information required to handle your inquiry or complaint. In chat, timestamps, session IDs, system responses, and technical browser or device information may also be processed.
Why? We use this data to handle your question, complaint, or request, provide support, resolve issues, maintain security, and improve our services.

The chatbot uses Guru AI, the Google Gemini API, and self-hosted n8n workflows. Contact form and chat workflows are processed via n8n and Google Cloud Platform. Messages sent via the AI chatbot are processed to generate a response and operate the chat functionality. Access is restricted to authorized system administrators, developers, and customer service personnel as required for their duties. We configure our services so that chat data is not used to train general external AI models.

AI-generated responses may be incomplete or inaccurate. Do not use the chatbot for urgent, medical, or other professional decision-making. Do not share identity documents, full payment card numbers, or other sensitive information via the chatbot, unless strictly necessary and provided through an appropriately secured channel.
Legal basis: performance of the contract or requested service; legitimate interest in customer service, quality assurance, security, and bug fixing.

Retention period: routine chatbot conversations and contact form submissions are retained for 6 months. Formal complaints, technical escalations, and billing issues are retained for 24 months after final resolution. Data may be retained longer if a complaint, investigation, legal obligation, or dispute requires it.
4.7 What happens during phone contact?
Which data? When you contact us by telephone, we process your phone number, call contents, and other data you provide.
Why? We use this data to handle your inquiry, assist you, and perform our services.
Legal basis: performance of the contract or requested support, and/or legitimate interest in customer service and case documentation.

Call recording: phone calls may be recorded for quality, training, and security purposes. You will be informed of this in advance. Routine recordings are kept for a maximum of 3 months. When a recording is part of a formal complaint or dispute, it may be kept for up to 24 months after resolution or longer while proceedings are ongoing.
4.8 How do our newsletter and marketing communications work?

Which data? When you subscribe, we process your email address, date and time of subscription, subscription method, version of consent text, confirmation of subscription, and unsubscribe date. If you have granted consent, we may also track whether you opened a message and clicked on links.
Why? We use this data to send you news, inspiration, recipes, information on new products and offers, and to analyze our communication performance when consent has been given.

Subscription is voluntary and independent of creating an account. The checkbox is never pre-selected. Every newsletter includes an unsubscribe option. Following unsubscription, we retain only minimal data required to honor the opt-out and, where necessary, demonstrate that prior mailings were lawful.

Legal basis: consent. For certain messages to existing customers regarding our own similar products, a statutory soft opt-in exemption may apply, provided all legal criteria are met and an easy opt-out mechanism is offered.

Retention period: for as long as your subscription remains active. After unsubscription, we retain limited proof of consent for 5 years. A minimal suppression list record is retained as long as necessary to respect your unsubscribe request.
4.9 What do we do with abandoned carts and product recommendations?
Which data? We may process your name, email address, account ID, cart items and cart value, abandoned cart timestamp, past orders, viewed products, saved preferences, and interaction data.

Why? We temporarily store carts so you can resume shopping later. Where a valid legal basis exists, we may send you a reminder about an abandoned cart. Furthermore, we may recommend products on our website, in the app, in your account, or via email to make our services more relevant and convenient.
When product recommendations are sent via email, you can opt out via the unsubscribe link. You may also object to the processing of your data for direct marketing at support@asianspices.online.

Legal basis: consent where legally required; for existing customers, a statutory exemption may apply under specific conditions for our own similar products. For limited recommendations within the website, app, or account, we rely on legitimate interest insofar as processing is necessary, proportionate, and reasonably expected. For non-necessary tracking technologies, we request consent.

Retention period: guest shopping carts are stored for up to 30 days following last activity. Logged-in customer shopping carts are stored for up to 90 days following last activity, or until completed or cleared.
4.10 How do reviews work?

Which data? For review invitations, we may process your name, email address, order number, order date, and relevant order details, and share them with Trusted Shops. When you submit a review, your chosen display name, star rating, review text, reply, and any voluntary additional information may be processed. Your email address is never displayed publicly.
Why? We collect reviews to understand customer experiences, improve our products and service, help other shoppers make informed decisions, and verify review authenticity.
Leaving a review is voluntary. You may ignore invitations and, where offered by the service, opt out of future review requests.
Legal basis: legitimate interest in collecting and verifying authentic customer reviews and improving our service; consent where required for specific communications or tracking.

Retention period: a review is retained for as long as it remains published. Data used for invitations and verification is retained for a maximum of 24 months, unless a complaint or dispute necessitates longer retention.
4.11 How do we use data for food safety and product recalls?

Which data? We may use order records, purchased items, batch or product details, and contact details. If you voluntarily share information about an allergy, intolerance, adverse reaction, medication use, or other health issue, this may include special category personal data.

Why? We use this data to comply with statutory food and product safety obligations, traceability, safety warnings, and product recalls, and to investigate reports or complaints diligently. If a product is suspected of being unsafe or is recalled, we can contact customers who purchased the product directly.

We do not proactively request medical or health data. If you share such information voluntarily, we process it only to the extent strictly necessary to handle your report or complaint, ensure food or product safety, establish, exercise, or defend legal claims, or on the basis of another applicable statutory exemption for special category data.

Asian Spices is not a healthcare provider, does not diagnose medical conditions, and does not provide personal medical advice. Our customer service does not evaluate whether a product is suitable in combination with medication, health conditions, allergies, pregnancy, or breastfeeding. For medical questions or uncertainties, consult a doctor, pharmacist, or qualified healthcare professional, and always check product labels, ingredients, allergen warnings, and safety instructions.

Legal basis: legal obligation and/or legitimate interest in food and product safety; for health data, an applicable statutory exception for processing special category personal data, such as explicit consent or establishment of legal claims.

Retention period: health information shared voluntarily is accessible only to personnel who require it to handle the case. We retain this information for up to 24 months after final resolution, unless a legal obligation, recall, or legal dispute necessitates longer retention.
4.12 How do we use data for security, fraud prevention, and legal disputes?

Which data? We may process IP addresses, account IDs, session details, login attempts, device and browser information, technical logs, security alerts, and relevant account, order, payment, contact, and file records.
Why? We use this data to secure our systems, prevent and investigate unauthorized access, abuse, and fraud, resolve incidents, and establish, exercise, or defend legal claims.
Legal basis: legitimate interest and, where specifically applicable, compliance with a legal obligation.
Retention period: timeframes vary per log type and scenario; see Section 8.
4.13 How do the points program and recipe sharing work?

Which data? When participating in our points program, we process your account ID, point balance, points transactions, activities earning or redeeming points, and corresponding dates and times. If you submit a recipe, photo, or other content, we process the submitted content, your chosen display name, submission date, and moderation/publication records.

Why? We use this data to award and redeem points, administer program participation, moderate and publish community submissions, prevent abuse, and improve our community and services. You are responsible for submitted content and must not share third-party personal data without valid authorization.

Legal basis: performance of the contract for points program participation; consent or terms governing publication of voluntary submissions; legitimate interest in moderation, security, and abuse prevention.

Retention period: points balance and participation records are kept while your account is active and for up to 24 months thereafter, unless a legal obligation or dispute requires longer retention. Published recipes and community contributions remain visible as long as they form part of the platform. Upon account deletion, we unlink or anonymize contributions where possible. You may request removal of your submission.

sections.title: 5. Partner accounts and the partner environment

blocks.text: Partner stores use a dedicated partner portal within the Asian Spices platform. To evaluate partner applications and create, manage, and secure partner accounts, we process personal data of owners, representatives, staff, and contact persons of partner stores.
Which data do we process for partner registration?

items: Company name and trade name
KvK number
VAT identification number
Address registered with the Chamber of Commerce
Name and business contact details of owner, representative, or contact person
Proof of authority to act on behalf of the company, such as a power of attorney
Data required to verify the identity of the authorized representative
Account and login credentials

blocks.text: Data concerning usage and security of the partner portal.

Why? We use this data to evaluate and verify partner applications, verify corporate and contact details, enter into and perform the partnership agreement, manage and secure accounts, provide communication and support, process orders, and detect and investigate abuse or fraud.
Legal basis: performance of the partnership agreement and our legitimate interest in partner management, verification, and security.
Can multiple team members use the partner portal?

A partner store can grant access to multiple authorized staff members. For each user, we may process their name, business email address, business phone number, assigned user role, account and login credentials, and relevant security and usage logs.

Users receive access only to the data and features required for their specific role and responsibilities. The partner store is responsible for maintaining current user accounts and promptly blocking or removing access when an employee leaves or no longer requires access.
Which security data may we process?

For authentication and security, we may process login credentials, verification data, IP addresses, browser and device information, login timestamps, failed login attempts, session data, and security and audit logs.

Verification and payouts: for partner verification, we record the outcome, date, and method of identity and authorization checks. We do not store complete copies of identity documents by default. Where a copy is legally or demonstrably necessary, data is minimized and protected. For payouts, we process the account holder's name and bank account number (IBAN). Access to the partner portal is role-based, and MFA/OTP is enforced for authorized users.

Retention period: data of an active partner store is kept for the duration of the partnership. Upon termination, access is revoked immediately. Non-financial account and profile data is kept for up to 12 months thereafter. Rejected partner application data is kept for up to 6 months after final rejection. Financial and statutory accounting records are retained for the statutory retention period.

sections.title: 6. With whom do we share personal data?

blocks.text: We only share personal data when necessary to deliver our services, comply with a legal obligation, or when another valid legal ground exists. We do not sell or rent your personal data.
6.1 Partner Stores
We share with the assigned partner store only the data necessary to prepare the order and execute shipping. More information is in section 4.5.
6.2 Itsolutionsworldwide.BV

Itsolutionsworldwide.BV has access to the production environment and production data for technical operations, implementation, maintenance, security, support, troubleshooting, database management, quality assurance, and security updates. Access may occur from Pakistan and other pre-approved working locations.

Access is restricted to authorized roles, such as the Technical Lead, network/IT administrators, and the core development team. Access is configured on the basis of least privilege, role-based access controls, 2FA/MFA, and platform audit logs. Production data is never copied directly into development or staging environments; dummy or anonymized data is used for testing.

Itsolutionsworldwide.BV processes personal data on behalf of Asian Spices as a data processor. We have documented these arrangements in a Data Processing Agreement. For access originating from Pakistan, we use the European Commission's Standard Contractual Clauses (SCCs) alongside supplementary technical and organizational safeguards. We assess the risks of this transfer periodically.
6.3 Hosting, Domain, Database, and Source Code

Our website and web application are hosted on Vercel in a cloud/serverless environment. The domain and DNS are managed via GoDaddy. The primary production infrastructure is configured in France and Germany. The application uses PostgreSQL as its database. GitHub is used for source code hosting and version control.

Backups and disaster recovery solutions are implemented for business continuity and security. Cloud database and deployment backups are encrypted and retained on a rolling 30-day cycle. Production personal data is never stored as unmanaged local development backups.
6.4 Email

Mailboxes and mail servers, including mail.asianspices.online, are hosted on GoDaddy's cPanel environment. Automated order, payment, shipping, account, and password emails are dispatched via the GoDaddy cPanel SMTP server. For dispatch, name, email address, order or billing details, and delivery details where needed are processed. Technical mail delivery logs are retained for 30 days.
6.5 Payments

For payments and refunds, we use PAY. and PayPal. These parties process payment information under their own terms and privacy policies. Asian Spices receives only non-sensitive payment transaction details necessary for order processing, customer support, refunds, and accounting.
6.6 Shipping and Carriers

For shipping, we use CheapCargo and the carrier selected for the specific delivery. Necessary details are shared solely for creating the shipping label, dispatching the parcel, track-and-trace, and resolving delivery queries.
6.7 Accounting

For our financial records, we use E-boekhouden.nl. We process invoices, relevant order and payment details, and contact information necessary for statutory accounting. Only authorized personnel have access to accounting systems.
6.8 Chatbot, AI, and Customer Support

For chatbot and support workflows, we use Guru AI, Google Gemini, Google Cloud, and n8n. These providers process data only to the extent necessary for chatbot operations, routing, support, security, and quality assurance. We maintain appropriate contractual and technical agreements to minimize and safeguard processing.
6.9 Analytics, Cookies, and Similar Technologies

Where you provide consent, we use Google Tag Manager, Google Analytics 4, and Microsoft Clarity. These services may process technical and usage data. More information can be found in our Cookie Policy.
6.10 Reviews

For collecting, verifying, and publishing customer reviews, we use Trusted Shops. For review invitations, we may share your name, email address, order number, order date, and relevant purchase data. Trusted Shops may use this data to send invitations, link reviews to orders, verify authenticity, and manage published reviews.
6.11 Government Authorities and Legal Obligations

We may disclose personal data to competent public authorities, regulators, law enforcement agencies, tax authorities, or other parties where required by law or necessary for the establishment, exercise, or defense of legal claims.

sections.title: 7. Is data processed outside the European Economic Area?

blocks.text: Some service providers or authorized personnel may process or access personal data outside the European Economic Area (EEA). For example, authorized personnel of Itsolutionsworldwide.BV may access personal data from Pakistan for technical operations, maintenance, security, and technical support. International vendors may also utilize global infrastructure or support.

Whenever personal data is transferred outside the EEA, we ensure a valid transfer mechanism and appropriate safeguards. For access from Pakistan, we rely on the European Commission's Standard Contractual Clauses (SCCs), supplemented by technical and organizational security measures. For other international providers, we rely on an adequacy decision, Standard Contractual Clauses, or another valid data transfer mechanism depending on the processing involved.

sections.title: 8. How long do we retain personal data?

blocks.text: We do not retain personal data longer than necessary for the purposes for which it was collected, unless a statutory retention obligation or other justified requirement dictates a longer period. Below is an overview of key retention schedules. After expiry, we delete or anonymize the data, unless an exception applies.

rows: 7 years (10 years where OSS/IOSS obligations apply)
Routine chatbot and contact form records
Formal complaints, technical escalations, billing disputes
24 months after final resolution (longer if dispute is ongoing)
Up to 24 months after last activity
Visible while account is active; tax records kept internally for 7 (or 10) years
90 days after last activity, or until completed/emptied
90 days (longer in case of security incident/investigation)
While active; 5 years proof retention after unsubscription
While published; invitation/verification records max. 24 months
Max. 24 months after resolution, or longer during proceedings
Non-financial: max. 12 months; financial/tax: statutory legal retention

sections.title: 9. How do we protect personal data?

blocks.text: We implement appropriate technical and organizational measures to safeguard personal data against loss, misuse, unauthorized access, unwanted disclosure, and unauthorized alteration.
We employ the following security measures, among others:

items: HTTPS/TLS encryption for website, app, APIs, and administrative consoles;
Role-based access controls and the principle of least privilege;
2FA/MFA for critical administrative, infrastructure, and development access;
One-way cryptographic password hashing with a unique salt;
Logging of relevant authentication, administrative, error, and security events;
Encryption of cloud backups and data in transit;
Restricted access to production data;
Dummy or anonymized datasets for development and testing environments;
Incident response and data breach management protocols;
Immediate revocation of access when personnel depart or change roles.

blocks.text: What happens in the event of a suspected data breach?

Suspected security incidents and data breaches are reported, evaluated, contained, investigated, and logged internally. If an incident affects Asian Spices personal data, Asian Spices is informed without undue delay. Where legally mandated, a data breach is notified in a timely manner to the Dutch Data Protection Authority (Autoriteit Persoonsgegevens) and affected individuals are informed.
Depending on the circumstances, you have the following rights:

items: Receive information about how your personal data is processed;
Access your personal data;
Rectify inaccurate or incomplete data;
Have personal data erased when statutory conditions are met;
Restrict data processing;
Receive your data in a portable format (data portability) where applicable;
Object to processing based on legitimate interests;
Object to direct marketing at any time;
Withdraw consent at any time, without affecting the lawfulness of prior processing;
Not be subject to decisions based solely on automated processing having legal or similarly significant effects, where statutory criteria apply.

blocks.text: You can submit a request via support@asianspices.online. We may ask for additional information to verify your identity. We generally respond within one month. For complex or numerous requests, this timeframe may be extended in accordance with statutory rules; you will be notified in good time.
Certain data cannot be erased immediately where we are required to retain it by law, for contract execution, for fraud prevention, or for the establishment, exercise, or defense of legal claims.
Filing a Complaint

If you have a complaint regarding how we handle personal data, please contact us first at support@asianspices.online. Additionally, you have the right to lodge a complaint with the Dutch Data Protection Authority (Autoriteit Persoonsgegevens).

sections.title: 11. Do we use profiling or automated decision-making?

blocks.text: We use limited automated personalization to display relevant products or suggestions based on, for example, previous orders, viewed items, preferences, or shopping cart details. This processing may be classified as profiling.

We do not make decisions based solely on automated processing that produce legal effects concerning you or similarly significantly affect you. Decisions with significant impacts on customer accounts or orders are taken or reviewed by qualified human personnel.

Where personalization relies on non-necessary cookies, similar tracking technologies, or consent for personalized marketing, you can withdraw your consent via cookie/privacy settings or the unsubscribe link in our communications. You can adjust your personalization and marketing preferences anytime via your account, cookie settings, or email opt-out links.
Creating a customer account and placing orders on our website and app is intended exclusively for individuals aged 18 and older.

When registering an account or placing an order as a guest, we require you to confirm that you are 18 years of age or older. We record this declaration alongside the date and timestamp when made. For this purpose, we do not routinely request your full date of birth.

We do not knowingly collect account or order information from individuals under the age of 18. If you, as a parent or legal guardian, suspect that a minor has provided personal data contrary to our age policy, please contact us at support@asianspices.online. We will investigate the report and delete or restrict the data where appropriate, unless retention is legally required.

sections.title: 13. Links to Third-Party Websites and Services

blocks.text: Our website and app may contain links to websites, apps, or services operated by other organizations. When accessing an external service, the privacy policy of that organization applies. We encourage you to review the privacy notices of those parties. The Asian Spices partner portal forms part of our proprietary platform and is governed by this policy.

We use cookies and similar technologies to ensure our website, webshop, and app function smoothly, remember preferences, and — where you grant consent — analyze usage of our services and support marketing. For more details on the technologies used, purposes, providers, and retention durations, please consult our Cookie Policy.

To the extent that personal data is processed through cookies or similar technologies, this Privacy Policy also applies. You can update your cookie preferences at any time via the cookie settings on our website.

We may update this privacy policy when our services, systems, vendors, or laws and regulations evolve. The most current version is published on our website. In the case of material changes, we will inform you where legally required or appropriate. The date of the most recent revision is stated at the top of this policy.
